summary: Admissions data & match scores for law, medical, dental, MBA, pharmacy, vet, optometry schools
offersHint: Admissions data & match scores for law, medical, dental, MBA, pharmacy, vet, optometry schools · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://admitbase.com/api/mcp · Optional headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Bearer amb_... key (generate at https://admitbase.com/profile#api-keys) to unlock the personalised tools save_my_stats and compare_to_applicants. The three read-only tools work with no header.

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Optional. Bearer amb_... key (generate at https://admitbase.com/profile#api-keys) to unlock the personalised tools save_my_stats and compare_to_applicants. The three read-only tools work with no header.

toolsPreview.name: search_schools
toolsPreview.description: Search professional schools (law, medical, dental, MBA, pharmacy, veterinary, optometry) by program type, name, or ranking range. Returns admissions stats and AdmitBase links. Public — no authentication required.

toolsPreview.name: get_school_stats
toolsPreview.description: Get full admissions statistics for a specific school: GPA/test percentiles, acceptance rate, class size, tuition, employment outcomes. Public — no authentication required.

toolsPreview.name: calculate_match_score
toolsPreview.description: Given a user's GPA and test score, calculate match category (Safety/Target/Reach/Far Reach), admission probability, and percentiles for one school or a ranked list. Public — no authentication required.

toolsPreview.name: save_my_stats
toolsPreview.description: Save a user's GPA and test score per program under their AdmitBase API key. Requires `Authorization: Bearer amb_...` header (generate one at https://admitbase.com/profile#api-keys).

toolsPreview.name: compare_to_applicants
toolsPreview.description: Compare a user's saved stats against anonymous community outcome reports (accepted/waitlisted/rejected). Requires `Authorization: Bearer amb_...` header.
